note: Every figure is approximate and every weighting directional. Fold lengths vary by device, font size and accessibility settings; ranking changes without announcement. Mirrors references/platform-mechanics.md — keep the two in step.

linkedin.label: LinkedIn
linkedin.governing_signal: Dwell time, then comments weighted far above likes
rewards: Dwell time — how long the post holds a scroll
Early engagement from the first-degree network
suppresses: Outbound links in the post body — move them to the first comment
Posting more than once in ~18 hours
linkedin.format_rules: Short lines, one idea per line, no more than two consecutive lines of prose before a break.

x.label: X
x.governing_signal: Reply velocity in the first ~30 minutes
rewards: Reply velocity in the first ~30 minutes
Replies over likes; likes over reposts for early ranking
Time spent on the post, including profile clicks
The author replying inside their own thread
suppresses: Posts nobody replies to within the first hour
x.format_rules: The first two lines carry the post; longer posts collapse behind Show more.

instagram.label: Instagram
instagram.governing_signal: Saves and sends over likes; the first frame decides whether the caption exists
rewards: Sends to DMs — the strongest single signal
instagram.format_rules: The caption is secondary — the first frame is the real hook.

tiktok.label: TikTok
tiktok.governing_signal: Watch-through percentage, decided in the first 1.5 seconds
suppresses: Length beyond what the idea supports
Obvious ad structure in the first frames
tiktok.format_rules: The caption is barely read; the first 1.5 seconds of video is the hook.

reddit.label: Reddit
reddit.governing_signal: Subreddit norms and early vote velocity; the title is the entire hook
rewards: Early upvote velocity in the first hour
Titles that state the substance plainly
Comment depth and the author replying
suppresses: Accounts with no history in the subreddit
Cross-posting the same text to several subreddits
Links to the author's own site or newsletter
reddit.format_rules: Subreddit norms override every general rule. Curiosity-gap titles read as clickbait here.

youtube.label: YouTube
youtube.governing_signal: CTR multiplied by average view duration — either alone is misleading
rewards: Click-through rate on the thumbnail and title
Average view duration and average percentage viewed
Session time — viewers who keep watching afterwards
suppresses: Titles that overpromise relative to the video
Slow openings before the payoff is named
Thumbnails that require reading to understand
youtube.format_rules: Title truncates around 60 characters — load-bearing words first. The first 15 seconds restate the title's promise.

facebook.label: Facebook
facebook.governing_signal: Meaningful interactions; link previews rank differently from native text
facebook.format_rules: Link previews rank differently from native text.

threads.label: Threads
threads.governing_signal: Behaves closer to X than to Instagram; replies drive distribution
threads.format_rules: About 4-5 lines visible; the first line carries it.
